segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and today we have an elementary level lesson for you.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们为您准备了一个初级课程。

segments.en: This is about fixing things.
segments.zh: 这期讲的是修理东西。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So sometimes in our office or in our house, some small things may break like maybe the door or the air conditioning.
segments.zh: 所以有时在我们的办公室或家里，一些小东西可能会坏掉，比如门或空调。

segments.en: So in this case, we need to call a special guy to come and fix it.
segments.zh: 所以遇到这种情况，我们需要找个专门的师傅来修。

segments.en: So let's listen to today's dialogue and we'll be back in a moment to talk about who this guy is.
segments.zh: 所以让我们听听今天的对话，我们稍后会回来谈论这个人是谁。

segments.en: The air conditioning is not working.
segments.zh: 空调不工作。

segments.en: We need to call a handyman before we start to fry in here.
segments.zh: 得赶紧叫维修师傅来，不然我们都要在这里热熟了。

segments.en: Dan is on top of that.
segments.zh: 丹已经在处理了。

segments.en: I think they are also getting the handyman to fix the bathroom toilet that keeps clogging up.
segments.zh: 我认为他们也让勤杂工来修理不断堵塞的浴室马桶。

segments.en: That would be convenient.
segments.zh: 那会很方便。

segments.en: They might as well ask him to fix the electrical wiring.
segments.zh: 他们不妨要求他修理电线。

segments.en: The circuit breakers keep going out all the time.
segments.zh: 断路器老是跳闸。

segments.en: It's really annoying.
segments.zh: 真烦人。

segments.en: Yeah, you're right.
segments.zh: 对，你说得对。

segments.en: This office is falling apart.
segments.zh: 这间办公室到处都快坏了。

segments.en: Frank told me the other day that the gutters outside were clogged and that's why the parking lot was flooded.
segments.zh: 前几天弗兰克告诉我，外面的排水沟被堵塞了，这就是停车场被淹的原因。

segments.en: I know.
segments.zh: 我知道。

segments.en: I was in ankle deep water trying to get to my car that day.
segments.zh: 那天我趟着没过脚踝的水去开车。

segments.en: The handyman definitely has his work cut out for him.
segments.zh: 这下维修师傅可有得忙了。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So now let's take a look at some of those key words and phrases on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以现在让我们来看看语言要点中的一些关键词和短语。

segments.en: Language Takeaway Our first word today is the name of this job.
segments.zh: 语言要点 我们今天的第一个词是这项工作的名称。

segments.en: The person is called a handyman.
segments.zh: 这个人被称为杂工。

segments.en: Okay, so that's a profession.
segments.zh: 好吧，这是一个职业。

segments.en: You are a handyman.
segments.zh: 你是个勤杂工。

segments.en: Now what exactly does a handyman do?
segments.zh: 现在勤杂工到底是做什么的？

segments.en: Well, a handyman fixes things.
segments.zh: 好吧，勤杂工是修东西的。

segments.en: He is usually a generalist.
segments.zh: 他通常是一个通才。

segments.en: He fixes things all over the house, not just the bathroom or the kitchen.
segments.zh: 他把房子里的东西都修好，不仅仅是浴室或厨房。

segments.en: So he can just fix things that are a little bit broken.
segments.zh: 所以他可以修复有点破损的东西。

segments.en: But if, for example, your car needs a new radiator or it needs a new important part, maybe you would take the car to someone who is more experienced with cars.
segments.zh: 但是，例如，如果您的汽车需要一个新的散热器，或者需要一个重要部件，也许您会把车送到对汽车更在行的人那里。

segments.en: But in the case of a handyman, if anything is broken, he can generally fix it.
segments.zh: 不过就勤杂工而言，东西坏了，他通常都能修。

segments.en: Okay, so as Catherine explained, basically a handyman just does any type or many types of general work of things that may be broken around the house or the office.
segments.zh: 好吧，正如凯瑟琳解释的那样，基本上，房子或办公室里什么东西坏了，勤杂工都能修，各种一般的活儿他都干。

segments.en: We had a couple of examples of these in today's dialogue, didn't we?
segments.zh: 在今天的对话中，我们有几个例子，不是吗？

segments.en: What was that first one?
segments.zh: 第一个是什么？

segments.en: Kind of gross.
segments.zh: 有点恶心。

segments.en: Yeah, well, he had to fix the air conditioning, but then he also had to fix the bathroom toilet because it kept clogging up.
segments.zh: 是的，好吧，他不得不修理空调，但后来他也不得不修理浴室马桶，因为它一直堵塞。

segments.en: Okay, so a toilet gets clogged up.
segments.zh: 好吧，马桶堵了。

segments.en: To clog up.
segments.zh: 堵塞。

segments.en: What does this mean?
segments.zh: 这是什么意思？

segments.en: So it means that something is blocking the way of the water being able to go out.
segments.zh: 所以这意味着有些东西挡住了水能出去的路。

segments.en: So the water doesn't go down.
segments.zh: 所以水就排不下去。

segments.en: And sometimes if the toilet is really clogged and someone tries to flush the toilet again, the water comes onto the floor and it's very dirty and very gross.
segments.zh: 有时，如果马桶真的堵塞了，有人试图冲马桶，水会落到地板上，很脏，很恶心。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So actually, maybe sometimes in the kitchen, pieces of food may fall into the sink and it may clog up the sink.
segments.zh: 所以实际上，也许有时在厨房里，食物可能会掉进水槽，它可能会堵塞水槽。

segments.en: Okay, so to clog up means to block or to get in the way of.
segments.zh: 好的，所以堵塞意味着阻塞或妨碍。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And apart from the toilets being clogged up, he also may have to take a look at the circuit breakers.
segments.zh: 除了马桶被堵塞外，他还可能不得不看看断路器。

segments.en: All right, so this is not about water or about plumbing.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以这与水或管道无关。

segments.en: Circuit breakers have to do with electricity.
segments.zh: 断路器与电力有关。

segments.en: And in this case, that box in your apartment or near your apartment that controls the different circuits.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，您公寓或公寓附近控制不同电路的那个盒子。

segments.en: So sometimes if the lights go out, you know that you have to check the circuit breaker and make sure that the circuits are all working properly.
segments.zh: 所以有时如果灯熄灭，你知道你必须检查断路器并确保电路都正常工作。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So the circuit breakers are kind of like a protection from too much electricity and that's why they go out.
segments.zh: 所以断路器有点像防止电流过大的保护装置，这就是它们跳闸的原因。

segments.en: And now for our final word on language takeaway, something that also got clogged up at their office, we're talking about the gutters.
segments.zh: 现在来看语言要点的最后一个词，也是他们办公室里被堵住的那样东西，我们要说的是排水沟。

segments.en: All right, so many people's houses have gutters or sometimes an office building will have gutters.
segments.zh: 好吧，很多人的房子都有排水沟，或者有时办公楼会有排水沟。

segments.en: These are trays on the roof of a house or a building that will catch the water when it rains.
segments.zh: 这些是房子或建筑物屋顶上的槽，下雨时用来接水。

segments.en: Because you know, sometimes rainwater can be very, very heavy and it's dangerous on your house, on the roof of your house because it can hurt the roof.
segments.zh: 因为你知道，有时雨会下得非常大，对房子、对屋顶都很危险，因为它会损坏屋顶。

segments.en: But if it comes into this gutter, into this little tray, then it will come down and fall on the ground.
segments.zh: 但如果它进入这个排水沟，进入这个小托盘，那么它就会倒在地上。

segments.en: So these are a way to protect your roof.
segments.zh: 所以这些是保护屋顶的一种方式。

segments.en: But these often get clogged up with leaves and with garbage.
segments.zh: 但这些经常被树叶和垃圾堵塞。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So they're like small little ways or little roads, if you want to call them, where the water can go and escape and go into a specific place.
segments.zh: 所以它们就像一条条小路、小通道——如果你愿意这么叫的话——水可以顺着流走，流到特定的地方。

segments.en: We have them on the sides of roads as well, many times.
segments.zh: 路边也经常有这种东西。

segments.en: So gutters that you find on the ground, sometimes you find them on the roof of a house, but those are a little bit different.
segments.zh: 所以你在地上找到的排水沟，有时你会在房子的屋顶上找到它们，但它们有点不同。

segments.en: The gutters on the ground are basically pathways for water to come down.
segments.zh: 地面上的排水沟基本上是水落下的通道。

segments.en: Because if there's no gutter, then all of the water is on the road and it can flood very quickly.
segments.zh: 因为如果没有排水沟，那么所有的水都在路上，它会很快泛滥。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And so this is a way for the water and even the garbage to go on the side of the road and not be in the way of the cars.
segments.zh: 所以这样水甚至垃圾都能流到路边，不挡住汽车。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: You see them on highways and roads very often because you don't want the road filled with water.
segments.zh: 您经常在高速公路和道路上看到它们，因为您不希望道路充满水。

segments.en: So these gutters are a small path where all the water will fall into it and escape safely from the highway.
segments.zh: 所以这些排水沟就是一条小路，所有的水都会流进去，安全地从高速公路上排走。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So that's all the time we have for Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 这就是我们所有的语言要点时间。

segments.en: Why don't we go back, have another listen to the dialogue and we'll be back soon with Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不回去，再听一次对话，我们很快就会带着流利表达回来。

segments.zh: 空调不工作。

segments.en: We need to call a handyman before we start to fry in here.

segments.en: Dan is on top of that.
segments.zh: 丹已经在处理了。

segments.zh: 我认为他们也让勤杂工来修理不断堵塞的浴室马桶。

segments.en: That would be convenient.
segments.zh: 那会很方便。

segments.en: They might as well ask him to fix the electrical wiring.
segments.zh: 他们不妨要求他修理电线。

segments.en: The circuit breakers keep going out all the time.
segments.zh: 断路器老是跳闸。

segments.en: It's really annoying.
segments.zh: 真烦人。

segments.en: Yeah, you're right.
segments.zh: 对，你说得对。

segments.en: This office is falling apart.
segments.zh: 这间办公室快散架了。

segments.en: Frank told me the other day that the gutters outside were clogged and that's why the parking lot was flooded.
segments.zh: 前几天弗兰克告诉我，外面的排水沟被堵塞了，这就是停车场被淹的原因。

segments.en: I know.
segments.zh: 我知道。

segments.en: I was in ankle deep water trying to get to my car that day.
segments.zh: 那天我趟着没过脚踝的水去开车。

segments.en: The handyman definitely has his work cut out for him.
segments.zh: 这下维修师傅可有得忙了。

segments.en: Now let's take a look at three key phrases on Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 现在让我们来看看关于流利表达的三个关键短语。

segments.en: Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 流利表达。

segments.en: Well, this first phrase is a phrase that I like to use and I do use it very often.
segments.zh: 好吧，第一个短语是我喜欢使用的短语，而且我确实经常使用它。

segments.en: We heard that Dan is on top of that.
segments.zh: 我们听说丹已经在处理了。

segments.en: We need to call a handyman in here and he says, nope, Dan is on top of that.
segments.zh: 我们需要叫个师傅来这里，他说，不用，丹已经在处理了。

segments.en: To be on top of something, what does it mean?
segments.zh: 掌握某事，这是什么意思？

segments.en: When she says Dan is on top of that, she's basically saying Dan is taking care of this or Dan is already calling the handyman to come and fix it.
segments.zh: 当她说丹已经在处理了，她基本上是在说丹正在管这件事，或者丹已经打电话叫师傅来修了。

segments.en: You are aware of the problem and you're trying to solve it.
segments.zh: 你知道问题并试图解决它。

segments.en: Okay, so don't worry.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以不要担心。

segments.en: You don't have to call the handyman.
segments.zh: 你不必打电话给勤杂工。

segments.en: Dan is on top of that.
segments.zh: 丹已经在处理了。

segments.en: Dan will call him.
segments.zh: 丹会给他打电话。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So to be on top of something is to make sure that something is done.
segments.zh: 因此，掌握某事就是确保完成某事。

segments.en: So you could say, you know, Marco, I really, I hope you stay on top of that project because it's very important.
segments.zh: 所以你可以说，你知道，Marco，我真的希望你能盯紧那个项目，因为它非常重要。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Or don't worry, the report will be finished on time.
segments.zh: 或者不用担心，报告将按时完成。

segments.en: I am on top of that.
segments.zh: 我在盯着呢。

segments.en: Great.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Now moving on to our next phrase, they were talking about all the problems that this office has and the person said, well, they might as well ask the handyman to also fix the electrical wiring.
segments.zh: 现在继续我们的下一个短语，他们正在谈论这个办公室遇到的所有问题，那个人说，好吧，他们不妨要求杂工也修理电线。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So this phrase might as well is, it's kind of hard to understand I think sometimes.
segments.zh: 所以 might as well 这个短语，我觉得有时候不太好理解。

segments.en: Basically what the speaker is saying is that while he is doing this, he can also do something else.
segments.zh: 基本上，演讲者所说的是，当他这样做时，他也可以做其他事情。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So he's here.
segments.zh: 所以他在这里。

segments.en: He can fix many things.
segments.zh: 他可以解决很多问题。

segments.en: He might as well also fix electrical wiring.
segments.zh: 他不妨顺便也把电线修了。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So taking advantage of the fact that you are already doing something or you are already here, you can start doing something else as well.
segments.zh: 因此，利用您已经在做某事或您已经在这里的事实，您也可以开始做其他事情。

segments.en: Or maybe we could say this in a different context to like, you know, we're going to order a pizza for lunch.
segments.zh: 或者我们可以在不同的背景下说，你知道，我们要点一份披萨作为午餐。

segments.en: You know what, Marco might as well order two because there are so many people here.
segments.zh: 你知道吗，Marco 不妨订购两个，因为这里有很多人。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So taking advantage of the fact that we are ordering pizza, we might as well get more for everyone.
segments.zh: 因此，利用我们订购披萨的事实，我们不妨为每个人获得更多。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And for our last phrase, when they mentioned all the work that has to be done, they said the handyman definitely has his work cut out for him.
segments.zh: 最后来看最后一个短语，当他们提到所有必须完成的工作时，他们说，这下勤杂工可有得忙了。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So if someone has his work cut out for him, it means that he has a lot of work to do.
segments.zh: 所以，如果说某人 has his work cut out for him，意思就是他有很多工作要做。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: You can also say this to someone that you're talking to.
segments.zh: 您也可以对您正在与之交谈的人说这句话。

segments.en: So Marco, Marco is writing a book.
segments.zh: 所以马可，马可正在写一本书。

segments.en: I say, Hey Marco, that's a really long book you're writing.
segments.zh: 我说，嘿，马可，你正在写的一本很长的书。

segments.en: It looks like you really have your work cut out for you.
segments.zh: 看起来你接下来可有得忙了。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Or maybe this project is really difficult.
segments.zh: 或者也许这个项目真的很困难。

segments.en: I really have my work cut out.
segments.zh: 我要干的活可真不少。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So you're basically saying I have a very hard time ahead of me.
segments.zh: 所以你基本上是在说，我接下来有得忙了。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So that's all the phrases we have for you.
segments.zh: 这就是我们为您准备的所有短语。

segments.zh: 前几天弗兰克告诉我，外面的排水沟被堵塞了，这就是停车场被淹的原因。

segments.en: I know.
segments.zh: 我知道。

segments.zh: 那天我趟着没过脚踝的水去开车。

segments.en: The handyman definitely has his work cut out for him.
segments.zh: 这下维修师傅可有得忙了。

segments.en: So a handyman is also commonly referred to as a jack of all trades.
segments.zh: 因此，勤杂工也通常被称为 jack of all trades（万事通）。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So these are both kind of funny words.
segments.zh: 所以这两个词都是有趣的。

segments.en: First of all, handy as an adjective means useful or helpful.
segments.zh: 首先，handy 作形容词意思是好用的、有帮助的。

segments.en: So maybe a hammer is a handy tool.
segments.zh: 所以也许锤子就是个好用的工具。

segments.en: It's a very handy tool or I find my iPhone has some very handy applications.
segments.zh: 这是个非常好用的工具，或者我觉得我的 iPhone 上有一些很好用的应用。

segments.en: I can use the dictionary.
segments.zh: 我可以使用字典。

segments.en: So a handyman is someone who's helpful.
segments.zh: 所以勤杂工是乐于助人的人。

segments.en: He can do many things.
segments.zh: 他可以做很多事情。

segments.en: But a jack of all trades is very special because it means he is a person that can do basically any job.
segments.zh: 但万事通是非常特别的，因为这意味着他是一个基本上可以做任何工作的人。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So sometimes in offices, people may have someone that they may refer to as a jack of all trades.
segments.zh: 所以有时在办公室里，人们可能会有人称之为万事通。

segments.en: So he may fix the computers.
segments.zh: 所以他可以修理电脑。

segments.en: He also knows a little bit about marketing and does many odd and random things around the office.
segments.zh: 他还对营销有一点了解，并且在办公室周围做了许多奇怪和随机的事情。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: You could say my friend Paul, he's a jack of all trades.
segments.zh: 你可以说我的朋友保罗，他是个多才多艺的人。

segments.en: He can fix a car.
segments.zh: 他可以修车。

segments.en: He can cook.
segments.zh: 他会做饭。

segments.en: He can fix a door or a window, but he can also sew.
segments.zh: 他可以修理一扇门或一扇窗户，但他也可以缝纫。

segments.en: So he's a jack of all trades.
segments.zh: 所以他是万能的。

segments.en: He has many, many skills.
segments.zh: 他有很多很多的技能。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And talking about these skills, being a handyman is not a profession per se.
segments.zh: 说到这些技能，当勤杂工本身并不是一种职业。

segments.en: It's actually a trade.
segments.zh: 这其实是一门手艺。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And so we say this because it's something that you normally do with your hands and you don't have to go to university to study it.
segments.zh: 所以我们这么说是因为这是你通常用手做的事情，你不必去大学学习它。

segments.en: You maybe have an apprenticeship where you study by working.
segments.zh: 你可能有一个通过工作学习的学徒期。

segments.en: And it's one of a few very, very important trades like being a plumber or an electrician.
segments.zh: 它是少数非常非常重要的行业之一，例如水管工或电工。

segments.en: But a handyman is more general.
segments.zh: 但勤杂工更一般。

segments.en: Like we said, you can do many different things.
segments.zh: 就像我们说的，你可以做很多不同的事情。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So very interesting.
segments.zh: 非常有趣。

segments.en: There are many trades out there.
segments.zh: 这样的手艺有很多。

segments.en: Maybe you can come on the site and mention some of these that you may know.
segments.zh: 也许您可以访问该网站并提及其中一些您可能知道的。

segments.en: Like for example, a very well known trade is a cobbler, a person that makes shoes.
segments.zh: 例如，一个非常知名的行业是鞋匠，一个制造鞋子的人。

segments.en: Makes shoes or fixes shoes.
segments.zh: 做鞋或修鞋。

segments.en: It's a very weird word though because shoes and cobbler don't seem to have much to do with each other.
segments.zh: 不过，这是一个非常奇怪的词，因为鞋子和鞋匠似乎彼此没有太大关系。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Well, many, many, many trades like this.
segments.zh: 嗯，像这样的手艺还有很多很多。

segments.en: I know before they used to be blacksmiths.
segments.zh: 我知道他们以前是铁匠。

segments.en: So many types of trades.
segments.zh: 这么多不同的手艺。
